title: 군사법원 판결서 등의 열람 및 복사에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
title_original: 군사법원 판결서 등의 열람 및 복사에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 6 (Restrictions on Perusal and Copying)
(1) Where any case under the subparagraphs of Article 93-3 (1) of the Act applies, a court clerk may restrict the perusal and copying of judgment documents, etc. concerning judgments of the military court to which the clerk belongs, judgments in higher-instance proceedings, judgments subject to retrial, etc. [Amended on June 30, 2022.]
(2) A person involved in litigation may apply to the clerk of the military court keeping the litigation records (or, after the judgment has become final, the military court that pronounced the judgment) to restrict perusal and copying of the judgment documents, etc. under paragraph (1), pursuant to the items of Article 93-3 (1) 5 of the Act. In such cases, until the disposition on that application becomes final, third parties may not apply to peruse or copy the relevant judgment documents, etc.
(3) Where perusal and copying have been restricted under paragraph (1) or the latter sentence of paragraph (2), a person involved in litigation or an interested third party may, after the judgment has become final and upon substantiating justifiable grounds, apply to the clerk of the military court that pronounced the judgment to peruse and copy the judgment documents, etc.
(4) A person who objects to a court clerk's disposition rejecting an application under paragraph (2), or to a court clerk's disposition on an application under paragraph (3), may apply to the military court to which the clerk belongs for revocation or alteration of that disposition. Provided, however, that an application for revocation or alteration of a clerk's disposition rejecting an application under paragraph (2) shall be made within three days from the date on which notice of the disposition is received; in such cases, Articles 466 and 467 of the Act shall apply mutatis mutandis.
